## Assumptions to prove

- [ ] Supported sample SQL schema verified.
- [ ] All source writers identified.
- [ ] Target identity and permissions defined.
- [ ] File-content scope distinguished from ACL/SMB scope.
- [ ] Private network and DNS prerequisites understood.
- [ ] Optional Azure Migrate assessment assumptions recorded.
- [ ] Cost estimate and cleanup owner identified.
